correction.family: one declared survival question; PH screening descriptive

plan.censoring_assumption: Independent administrative followup; fixture mechanism, not observed-data proof
plan.origin: Common protocol origin, durations measured after enrolment origin

provenance.backend: statsmodels KM/logrank/Cox/CIF; scipy censored lognormal AFT analytic-score MLE

survival_plan.censoring_assumption: Independent administrative followup; fixture mechanism, not observed-data proof
survival_plan.origin: Common protocol origin, durations measured after enrolment origin

ph.interpretation: Trend plot/flag is screening, no calibrated PH p-test. No trend does not establish PH; crossing/non-PH requires another model.
ph.method: Descriptive Schoenfeld residual trend; Breslow risk-weighted means, Efron ties approximation explicitly labelled

c_index.method: Harrell right-censored comparable pairs; event/censor same-time comparable, two tied events excluded
c_index.scope: Apparent training discrimination, not held-out validation; censoring-distribution sensitive, not IPCW; no CI

time_dependent_auc.reason: Validated censoring-aware evaluation backend not implemented.

time_dependent_brier.reason: Validated IPCW train/evaluation censoring distribution and supported follow-up protocol not implemented; ordinary MSE is not survival Brier.

model.baseline_method: Breslow cumulative increments including current event; coefficients ties=breslow
model.inference: Partial likelihood Wald HR CI, not event probability

ph_diagnostics.interpretation: Trend plot/flag is screening, no calibrated PH p-test. No trend does not establish PH; crossing/non-PH requires another model.
ph_diagnostics.method: Descriptive Schoenfeld residual trend; Breslow risk-weighted means, Efron ties approximation explicitly labelled

model.prediction_limit: Delayed-entry model origin survival prediction not validated; conditional-on-entry prediction backend required.

prediction.interpretation: Conditional fitted survival S(t|baseline profile); not HR, causal effect or validated individual prognosis; no prediction CI

warnings: Censored kayıt kayıp/null veri değildir: bilinen son takip süresi risk set'e katkı verir. Independent censoring/truncation kullanıcı gerekçesidir; gözlenen veriden kanıtlanmaz. Hazard ratio event olasılığı değildir. KM complement competing cause incidence değildir. Model tanıları geçse bile güvenilirlik veya nedensellik kanıtı yok.
